statement: NVIDIA signed a definitive agreement to acquire Hugging Face for approximately $12.93 billion, taking ownership of the main distribution hub for open models and its stated 18 million developers.
why: Hugging Face is where most developers first find and run open models; owning that front door reinforces the pull toward NVIDIA accelerators and the software stack around them, extending demand beyond hardware alone.

impact.mechanism: Control of the dominant open-model repository steers default deployment paths toward NVIDIA hardware and its libraries, supporting merchant-GPU demand and lifting the open-weight and cluster-software layers that sit on top of it.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA announced a definitive agreement to acquire Hugging Face for approximately '$12.93 billion'

confidence.basis: Primary evidence: NVIDIA's own announcement, with the deal value tied to the related SEC 8-K entered into 2026-09-02.
